settings.description: Metadata and bodies are controlled separately for caller-facing and upstream traffic.
settings.saveError: Could not save capture settings. Retry.
settings.bodyBlocked: Body capture is refused until positive retention_days or max_database_size_mb is configured. Metadata capture remains available.

enable_downstream_log.label: Downstream metadata
enable_downstream_log.description: Record caller method, path, query, headers, response status, and response headers.

enable_downstream_log_body.label: Downstream bodies
enable_downstream_log_body.description: Include caller request and response bodies when a retention bound exists.

enable_upstream_log.label: Upstream metadata
enable_upstream_log.description: Record every upstream attempt, including method, URL, headers, provider, credential, and status.

enable_upstream_log_body.label: Upstream bodies
enable_upstream_log_body.description: Include request and response bodies for every upstream attempt when a retention bound exists.

disable_log_redaction.label: Disable log redaction
disable_log_redaction.description: Writes credentials, cookies, user content, and other sensitive values to the database in clear text. Only enable this temporarily on an instance you control.
